## The claim

Mitotic and meiotic trisomy are not separable at delta-BIC of 10 or more from arm-stratified allele-fraction band structure at cell fractions up to 20 percent, at this sample's depth and heterozygous-site counts.

**Prediction if true.** On simulated meiotic and mitotic trisomies injected at 5, 10 and 20 percent, the five-model comparison assigns the correct mechanism with delta-BIC of 10 or more in fewer than half the replicates; the mechanism is therefore reported as not identifiable rather than called.

**What would refute it.** The comparison separates the two mechanisms at delta-BIC of 10 or more in a majority of replicates -- the mechanism call is then a real measurement and is handed to step 7's Track 2 card.

## Evidence

Nothing observed yet. This claim is proposed, not tested.
